newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor trading stops over payment row.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor trading stops over payment row.

text.p: A deadlock over settlement of dues in a castorseed futures transaction on Tuesday stalled trading, brokers said.
They said the stalemate followed the failure of a speculative buyer in honouring his commitment.
"We are trying to solve the deadlock," said Navin Chandra Shah, president of the Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange.

In edible oils, groundnut oil rose three rupees to 339/340 rupees per 10 kg on fresh seasonal buying. Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose 7.0 rupees to 514/515 rupees per 15 kg on higher outstation demand.
Imported palm oil was steady at 278/279 rupees per 10 kg in nominal trading.
